relation: SL < Linf  (a von Bertalanffy grower never reaches its own asymptotic length)
note: Checks a design's standard length against the asymptotic length of the growth curve fitted to its own taxon. 'violated' means the design's length is impossible under that fitted curve; it does NOT mean the animal cannot be that long, because only 7 of 75 Exocoetidae species have a growth row and all 12 rows are a FishBase compilation (kind 'secondary') fitted in one locality and year. growth_Linf_m is not an engine state field today: it must be read from development/growth.json keyed by taxon, or declared by the design, and a design that supplies neither gets cannot-evaluate rather than a pass.
